---
title: "Validation"
subtitle: "Real enrollment vs. PopulationSim synthetic estimates, by district and county"
---

## Overview

This is the page the site is actually built around — where the real enrollment numbers
(`2_enrollment.qmd`) and PopulationSim's synthetic estimates (`3_synthetic.qmd`) get compared.

- **Objective**: for each school district, compare real (Utah DOE / NCES) K-12 enrollment against
  PopulationSim's synthetic K-12 student count (the real test, since that's uncontrolled) and
  against its synthetic age 3-18 population (a sanity bound, since that's controlled — not expected
  to match exactly). Same comparison for colleges by county, real (USHE / NCES-IPEDS) vs. synthetic
  sch_grade count (SCHG 15 and higher) and age 18-24 population.
- **What it reads**: the real district and county tables from `2_enrollment.qmd` and the synthetic
  district and county tables from `3_synthetic.qmd`, all in `_data/intermediate/`.
- **Box Elder**: reported separately from the other four counties, since its real and synthetic
  numbers are both scoped differently there (model region vs. full county) — a single pooled number
  would misrepresent it either way.
- **Output**: this page itself — the published comparison tables and charts, not another
  intermediate file.

## Setup

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

paths = {"intermediate": Path("_data/intermediate/")}
```

## 1. School validation (by district)

```{python}
real_district = pd.read_csv(paths["intermediate"] / "real_enrollment_by_district.csv")
synthetic_district = pd.read_csv(paths["intermediate"] / "synthetic_k12_by_district.csv")

school_validation = real_district.merge(
    synthetic_district, on="District Name", how="outer", indicator=True
)
# Every district should be in both tables; anything else is a join problem to fix before reading ratios
print("districts only in one table:", (school_validation["_merge"] != "both").sum())
school_validation = school_validation.drop(columns="_merge")

# Real enrollment already includes preschool (DOE totalk12 + preschool, NCES K-12 + PK), matching sch_grade
for col in ["sch_grade", "age_3_18"]:
    school_validation[f"{col}_vs_doe"] = school_validation[col] / school_validation["doe_enrollment"]
    school_validation[f"{col}_vs_nces"] = school_validation[col] / school_validation["nces_enrollment"]

school_counts = school_validation[
    ["District Name", "sch_grade", "age_3_18", "doe_enrollment", "nces_enrollment"]
].sort_values("doe_enrollment", ascending=False)
school_counts
```

```{python}
# Ratios: synthetic / real. 1.00 means the synthetic count equals the real one.
school_ratios = school_validation[
    ["District Name"] + [c for c in school_validation.columns if c.endswith(("_vs_doe", "_vs_nces"))]
].sort_values("District Name")
school_ratios.round(3)
```

## 2. College validation (by county)

```{python}
real_county = pd.read_csv(
    paths["intermediate"] / "real_enrollment_by_county.csv", dtype={"COUNTYFP": str}
)
synthetic_county = pd.read_csv(
    paths["intermediate"] / "synthetic_college_by_county.csv", dtype={"COUNTYFP": str}
)

college_validation = real_county.merge(
    synthetic_county, on="COUNTYFP", how="outer", indicator=True
)
# Every county should be in both tables; anything else is a join problem to fix before reading ratios
print("counties only in one table:", (college_validation["_merge"] != "both").sum())
college_validation = college_validation.drop(columns="_merge")

for col in ["sch_grade", "age_18_24"]:
    college_validation[f"{col}_vs_ushe"] = college_validation[col] / college_validation["ushe_enrollment"]
    college_validation[f"{col}_vs_nces"] = college_validation[col] / college_validation["nces_enrollment"]

college_validation.round(3)
```

## 4. Results

Pick any combination of school levels and districts. The chart adds up the selection: each district
shows real DOE and NCES enrollment next to the synthetic grade count and the synthetic age-band count.

```{ojs}
levelOrder = ["Pre-K", "K", "Elementary", "Middle", "High"]

// Age bands used for the sanity bound, one per level (the bands overlap at boundary ages)
ageBands = ({"Pre-K": [3, 5], "K": [5, 6], "Elementary": [6, 11], "Middle": [12, 14], "High": [15, 18]})

realByLevel = FileAttachment("_data/intermediate/real_by_district_level.csv").csv({typed: true})
synthByLevel = FileAttachment("_data/intermediate/synthetic_by_district_level.csv").csv({typed: true})
synthAge = FileAttachment("_data/intermediate/synthetic_age_by_district.csv").csv({typed: true})

levelRows = realByLevel.map(d => {
  const s = synthByLevel.find(x => x["District Name"] === d["District Name"] && x.Level === d.Level);
  return {
    district: d["District Name"],
    level: d.Level,
    doe: d.doe_enrollment ?? 0,
    nces: d.nces_enrollment ?? 0,
    grade: s ? s.sch_grade : 0
  };
})

districtNames = [...new Set(levelRows.map(d => d.district))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
//| layout-ncol: 3

viewof selectedLevels = Inputs.select(levelOrder, {
  label: "School levels",
  multiple: 5,
  value: levelOrder,
  format: lvl => `${lvl} (Age: ${ageBands[lvl][0]}-${ageBands[lvl][1]})`
})

viewof selectedDistricts = Inputs.select(districtNames, {
  label: "Districts",
  multiple: 5,
  value: districtNames
})

viewof splitByDistrict = Inputs.checkbox(["Split by district"], {
  label: "Chart",
  value: ["Split by district"]
})
```

```{ojs}
selectedFacet = splitByDistrict.length > 0
```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-level-compare
//| fig-cap: "Students by district for the selected school levels. DOE and NCES are K-12 plus preschool enrollment. Synthetic grade counts persons in the same grades. Synthetic age band counts persons in the selected levels' age bands, with each person counted once even where bands overlap."
//| fig-alt: "Grouped bar chart with one group per selected district. Each group has four bars: DOE, NCES, synthetic grade count and synthetic age-band count, for the selected school levels."

chartRows = {
  const out = [];
  for (const dist of selectedDistricts) {
    const rows = levelRows.filter(d => d.district === dist && selectedLevels.includes(d.level));
    if (!rows.length) continue;
    const ages = new Set();
    for (const lvl of selectedLevels) {
      const [lo, hi] = ageBands[lvl];
      for (let a = lo; a <= hi; a++) ages.add(a);
    }
    const ageTotal = d3.sum(
      synthAge.filter(d => d["District Name"] === dist && ages.has(d.age)),
      d => d.persons
    );
    out.push({district: dist, source: "DOE", students: d3.sum(rows, d => d.doe)});
    out.push({district: dist, source: "NCES", students: d3.sum(rows, d => d.nces)});
    out.push({district: dist, source: "Synthetic grade", students: d3.sum(rows, d => d.grade)});
    out.push({district: dist, source: "Synthetic age band", students: ageTotal});
  }
  if (selectedFacet) return out;
  // Split off: add the selected districts into one total per source
  return d3.rollups(out, v => d3.sum(v, d => d.students), d => d.source)
    .map(([source, students]) => ({district: "Total", source, students}));
}

chartRows.length === 0
  ? html`<p><em>Select at least one school level and one district.</em></p>`
  : Plot.plot({
      width: 960,
      height: 460,
      marginBottom: 60,
      grid: true,
      ...(selectedFacet ? {fx: {label: null, domain: selectedDistricts}} : {}),
      x: {axis: null},
      y: {label: "Students", grid: true},
      color: {
        legend: true,
        domain: ["DOE", "NCES", "Synthetic grade", "Synthetic age band"],
        range: ["#1f78b4", "#33a02c", "#e31a1c", "#ff7f00"]
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(chartRows, {
          ...(selectedFacet ? {fx: "district"} : {}),
          x: "source",
          y: "students",
          fill: "source",
          tip: true
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
```
